text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rates detected in US-WEST for model 'redwood-open-v2' via gateway (percent 5xx ~8% from baseline <0.2%). Alerts: errors.gateway.5xx spike. Paging oncall.
samir: I'm on it. pulling service map, can someone confirm scope? 5xx across all routes or specific prefix cache-backed endpoints?
elsa: seeing 5xx mostly on /generate and /chat, correlation with kv-prefix-cache miss rate. KV miss ratio jumped from 2% to 38% around 02:13 UTC.
ryan: logs show KV mismatch errors: "kv_prefix_checksum_mismatch" on multiple shards. suspect silent corruption after compaction job.
katie: tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. @mike can you look at recent compaction runs? we had one 02:12 UTC on shard-7.
mike: compaction ran, but job logs show repeated CRC warnings for shard-7. I paused compaction at 02:15 but by then traffic hit the bad keys. Starting deeper scan now.
alice: customer impact: internal SLO error budget consumption warning, roughly 6% of requests returning 5xx in US-WEST; a handful of customers are reporting timeouts and degraded p99. Opening incident ticket.
samir: immediate mitigation: enable prefix-cache bypass for US-WEST read traffic to reduce reliance on corrupted KV entries. Plan: rollout bypass to 5% of traffic -> 25% -> 100% if effective. Rolling bypass via routing flag: `routing.cache_prefix_bypass=us-west`.
ryan: applying flag for 5% now. command: `/deploy toggle routing.cache_prefix_bypass us-west 0.05`. 
deploy-bot: command accepted, starting gradual rollout.
elsa: monitoring latency and 5xx. If bypass reduces 5xx, we'll keep until we can repair kv shards.
mike: scan results: found ~0.4% keys with checksum mismatch; likely localized but causing high miss storms due to fanout. I can try a repair via shard snapshot restore from 01:50 UTC backup. That's ~20 minutes behind.
katie: risk assessment: restore will cause brief increased write latency for that shard and might drop some recent writes. Recommend routing writes to fallback replica during restore.
samir: agreed. Start snapshot restore on shard-7 only after bypass fully at 25% rollout. Also switch writes to replica and enable read-fallback to upstream model.
alice: customer comms: drafting status update. Will notify impacted customers in US-WEST, mention mitigation and ETA for full restore ~30-45m.
ryan: bypass at 25% now. 5xx dropped to ~2% and p99 latency improving.
elsa: good signal. escalate to eng-runtime to run consistency check job and plan compaction fix. @samir please coordinate.
samir: on it. I'm running consistency checker `tools/kv_check --shard=7 --fix-unsafe=false` to enumerate corrupt keys and produce patch list.
mike: starting snapshot restore in 5 mins. prepping fallback replica routing. command: `infra run restore --shard=7 --backup=1968121400` (backup at 01:50 UTC).
deploy-bot: restore initiated. Estimated 12 minutes.
elsa: while restore runs, keep bypass in place. if 5xx goes below 0.5% we can keep bypass and do gradual reroute of traffic back.
ryan: monitoring dashboards, 5xx now 0.6% and falling. Good.
alice: drafting external note: "We experienced elevated gateway errors related to prefix-cache inconsistency in US-WEST. We've enabled emergency cache bypass and are restoring affected shard from backup. No customer data loss expected; some recent requests may be unavailable during restore. ETA 30-45m."
samir: consistency checker output: 214 keys flagged, 6 hot keys with high fanout. I'll generate patch for hot keys first and apply in read-only mode.
mike: restore complete on shard-7. consistency checker re-run shows 0 flagged keys. Running compaction dry-run to validate.
elsa: compaction team please avoid auto-compaction on shard-7 for next 2 hours until warmup finishes.
ryan: removing bypass incrementally, routing traffic back now to baseline. doing 50% -> 100% over 5 mins.
deploy-bot: routing flag updated: 100% baseline.
samir: postmortem checklist: collect stack traces, save KV repair logs, note compaction job id and config, verify canary metrics. Assign owners: eng-runtime (samir,mike), eng-sre (elsa,ryan), customer-ops (alice,katie).
alice: sending customer update now. tagging legal for review? no legal needed for operational note.
katie: we should add a regression alert: compaction_crc_warning -> page oncall, don't auto-silence. I'll file monitoring PR.
samir: final update: incident mitigated, 5xx back to baseline, shard repaired from backup, compaction paused and will be examined. Will follow up with full postmortem in incidents channel in ~24h. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed by samir at 1968124099 UTC. Summary: KV prefix corruption on shard-7 -> elevated 5xx/timeouts in US-WEST. Mitigations: cache bypass, snapshot restore, consistency checker. Estimated customer impact: low (partial p99 degradations, temporary errors).
